defects.title: No controlled journey amendment or cancellation after departure
defects.actual: Journey legs are locked after booking; no amend/rebook/cancel operation exposed
defects.expected: Controlled versioned amendments and cancellation with revised legs, costs and documents
steps: Dispatch LEG1
Edit its planned departure to 11 November
Save: locked after booking
Review record actions: no supported amendment or cancellation
defects.fix: Provide versioned amendment/rebooking and cancellation workflows that preserve departed legs, approvals, costs and documents.

defects.title: Duplicate supplier invoice can become a second posted payable
steps: Use the settled S24 request and its supplier invoice number
Create another request for the same vendor and job
Upload the same invoice number, AED 100
Approve and post the resulting second bill
defects.expected: Reject a duplicate vendor/invoice identity or require an explicit audited exception
defects.actual: Second bill 728 is Posted and unpaid; first bill 699 was already Paid.
defects.fix: Enforce supplier legal-entity plus normalized invoice-number uniqueness before approval/posting, with a reviewed override.

defects.title: Automatic supplier bills and payables report identify the customer organization
defects.screen: Invoice request approval / Reports → Outstanding Payables
steps: Approve a vendor invoice request linked to a customer shipment
Open the generated bill
Open Outstanding Payables
defects.expected: Identify the supplier as the creditor and keep the shipment customer separately
defects.actual: BILL-000728 appears against the S24 Customer organization. Vendor login is stored separately, but no supplier organization is linked by approval.
defects.fix: Add a supplier-organization relationship to vendor accounts/requests/bills and use it in AP reports.

defects.title: No customs declaration/release workflow or dispatch gate
defects.actual: Only customs fields and a duty report are exposed
defects.expected: A clearance record, release/hold status and controlled dispatch
steps: Inspect customs-required/reference fields
Search menus and shipment actions for clearance/release
Continue the shipment lifecycle without a clearance document
defects.fix: Introduce declarations, entries, attachments, hold/release status and a release gate before dispatch where clearance is required.

defects.title: Hazardous cargo can progress without structured dangerous-goods acceptance data
defects.actual: Only hazardous flags, free text and attachments are present
defects.expected: Mode-appropriate UN/class/packing instruction and acceptance controls
steps: Create hazardous inquiry with package dimensions
Inspect DG acceptance fields
Book and dispatch without an approved DG declaration
defects.fix: Add structured mode-specific DG data, required supporting documents and an acceptance/release decision before dispatch.

defects.title: Mode-specific freight documents cannot be generated
steps: Open the saved shipment
Inspect generation/print actions
Only generic Print / save PDF and file attachments are available
defects.fix: Add versioned mode-specific documents and master/house links with numbering, validation and printable templates.

defects.title: Truck masters do not provide transport or fleet execution
steps: Inspect truck master fields and road booking form
Look for driver/vehicle assignment, trip sheet, permit, maintenance or POD controls
defects.expected: Assign and operate fleet trips with resource availability and delivery evidence
defects.actual: A generic Truck category and free-text carrier/vehicle fields are present; fleet operations are absent.
defects.fix: Add vehicle/driver/trip records, availability checks and delivery evidence.

defects.title: One job cannot receive supplier/customer bills in independent currencies

actual.test: AED customer invoice against USD job
actual.result: Document currency must match the linked job.

actual.test: EUR supplier invoice against USD job/request

result.error: Invoice totals must be positive, in the request currency, with a PDF or image.

defects.expected: EUR supplier bill and AED customer invoice against the same USD job, with base-currency accounting
steps: On S22 USD job 927, create an AED customer invoice and save
Open its USD supplier request upload form
Submit a EUR invoice through the authenticated API supplement
defects.fix: Allow document currencies distinct from the job, with dated exchange rates, base-currency ledgers and realized/unrealized FX handling.

defects.title: Temperature-control flag is lost when a quote becomes a shipment
defects.expected: Preserve temperature control in the operational job
steps: Create an inquiry with Temperature controlled checked
Prepare and accept the quotation
Convert it to a shipment and inspect the operational details
defects.fix: Preserve the temperature-control requirement and instructions throughout quote-to-job conversion and printing.

defects.title: Oversized cargo has no OOG approval, lashing or route-permit workflow
defects.actual: Dimensions are stored but no approval/permit gate is exposed
defects.expected: OOG limits, engineering approval, lashing plan and route permits
steps: Enter 420 x 280 x 310 cm, 6500 kg
Book and dispatch without OOG approvals
defects.fix: Add OOG assessment, permits, engineering/lashing approvals and shipment release requirements.

defects.title: Dimensions do not calculate volume or chargeable weight
steps: Enter package count and dimensions shown in test data
Save inquiry and prepare quotation without manually entering volume
Read declared volume / chargeable fields
defects.fix: Calculate unit-aware volume, gross totals and mode-specific chargeable quantities; support an explicit audited manual override.

defects.title: Supplier internal line notes disclose buying prices to customers
defects.expected: Vendor pricing notes remain internal
steps: Vendor: submit a rate with line Note INTERNAL-AUDIT-BUY-<currency>-<cost>
Admin: publish the quotation
Client: open quotation and read the charge Note column
defects.fix: Separate supplier-private notes from customer-facing descriptions and enforce that separation in both API projections and rendering.

defects.title: No operational workflow for split consignments and partial delivery
defects.expected: split consignments and partial delivery
steps: Create the scenario enquiry
Inspect booking and shipment actions for the required operation
defects.fix: Track booked, dispatched, delivered and remaining quantities per consignment and issue partial PODs.

defects.title: No operational workflow for master/house consolidation
defects.expected: master/house consolidation
steps: Create the scenario enquiry
Inspect booking and shipment actions for the required operation
defects.fix: Implement consolidation masters, multiple linked houses, container allocations and manifests.

defects.title: No operational workflow for groupage and multiple consignees
defects.expected: groupage and multiple consignees
steps: Create the scenario enquiry
Inspect booking and shipment actions for the required operation
defects.fix: Implement groupage loads with multiple consignments, consignees and per-consignment delivery.

defects.title: Generic invoice view lacks an issuable UAE tax-invoice template
steps: Open the taxable AED domestic invoice
Review available issuer, supplier TRN, supply-date and invoice template fields
Review foreign-currency invoice controls
defects.expected: Produce an appropriate configured tax invoice, including required issuer/recipient details and AED tax presentation where applicable
defects.actual: The invoice uses the generic record view and has no issuer TRN/address/template configuration or AED tax equivalent for foreign-currency documents.
defects.fix: Implement configurable legal invoice/credit-note templates with issuer identity, tax treatment and AED equivalents; verify applicable full/simplified/zero-rated exceptions.

defects.title: Temperature-controlled cargo has no setpoint or excursion workflow
defects.actual: Temperature checkbox and free-text specification only
defects.expected: Structured setpoint/range, reefer instructions and temperature events
steps: Set Temperature controlled
Enter -18 C in specification
Inspect shipment controls and milestones for temperature monitoring
defects.fix: Store setpoint, allowed range, reefer equipment and temperature/excursion events as structured operational data.

defects.title: Net weight greater than gross weight is accepted
steps: Create a valid quotation
Set gross weight 1000 kg and net weight 2000 kg
Save
defects.expected: Reject net weight above gross weight
defects.actual: The quotation saves with gross 1000 and net 2000.
defects.fix: Validate the relationship on enquiries, quotes, packages and shipments.

defects.title: Single-mode shipment accepts arrival before departure
steps: Enter ETD 10 Nov / ETA 1 Nov 2026
Enter ATD 11 Nov / ATA 2 Nov 2026
Save the otherwise valid shipment
defects.expected: Reject reversed planned and actual transport dates
defects.actual: All four contradictory dates persist in the saved shipment.
defects.fix: Validate ETD/ETA and ATD/ATA order as well as individual date syntax.

defects.title: Warehousing is a configuration name without inventory operations
steps: Create and activate the QA warehouse master
Look for receipts, locations, stock balances, movements, picks and dispatch allocations
defects.expected: Receive, store, allocate and release cargo with quantity/location traceability
defects.actual: Only a generic warehouse master record can be created. No stock workflow is exposed.
defects.fix: Implement stock movements and shipment-linked receipt/pick/dispatch records.

defects.title: Payment entry cannot select a bank account or journal
defects.actual: Payment forms expose amount/reference only; entries use Cash
defects.expected: Select cash/bank journal and post to the chosen ledger
steps: Record a supplier bank transfer or customer bank receipt
Inspect payment form: no journal/account selector
Inspect General ledger entries: Cash is used
defects.fix: Let payments select a configured bank/cash account and journal, and reconcile against bank activity.

defects.title: Earlier workspace exposes placeholder modules and a separate quote data set
steps: Open Earlier draft workspace
Use its ERP workspace and sidebar modules
Compare its quotation count to the main workspace
defects.expected: Navigation opens supported workflows and one consistent operational data set
defects.actual: The earlier workspace advertises incomplete workflows, several sidebar entries are placeholders, and its quotations differ from the main workspace.
defects.fix: Remove the obsolete entry point or migrate it to the main records and real module routes.

defects.title: Activated tariffs are not selectable or applied to quotations
steps: Create and activate the AED Dubai–Abu Dhabi sell tariff
Open a matching quotation and its charge controls
Look for rate discovery/application and validity selection
defects.expected: Apply the appropriate dated buy/sell tariff with its basis and source reference
defects.actual: Tariffs store charge lines, but quotation controls provide no tariff link or application action. Charges must be re-entered or imported manually.
defects.fix: Add explicit tariff selection with route/date/basis matching and charge provenance.

defects.title: Repeated partial credits leave tax and revenue balances after full reversal
steps: Post an AED 100 net + AED 5 VAT invoice
Post ten AED 10 gross credits and one AED 5 credit
Compare total credits and remaining ledger balances
defects.fix: Track remaining net/tax amounts and allocate final-credit rounding to fully reverse the original invoice. First credit was entered in Chrome; subsequent credits used the normal authenticated API.

defects.title: First row click after editing search is consumed by filter rendering
steps: Type the S22 title into Search without Tab or Enter
Click its visible record number
Observe that only the filtered list appears
Click the record number again to open details
defects.expected: The first row click opens the selected record
defects.actual: Search commits on change/blur and replaces the table during the first click; no record GET occurs until the second click.
defects.fix: Commit filtering before row activation or preserve the selected record through the filter render.
